articles.summary: Frontier Airlines (Nasdaq: ULCC) today opened reservations for its new First Class seats and unveiled additional cabin enhancements that will bring more extra-legroom Premium seating and in-seat power to its aircraft. The enhancements will complement Frontier's previously announced Starlink Wi-Fi, reshaping how customers experience Frontier by delivering more comfort, choice and connectivity while staying true to the airline's low fares commitment. Installation of First Class and extra-legroom seats has begun, with completion expected March 5, 2027. The new seating configuration will offer extra legroom throughout the first eight rows of the aircraft. First Class customers will enjoy spacious seats in a two-by-two configuration with up to 37 inches of pitch, while seats in rows three through eight will offer extra legroom with up to 34 inches of pitch. articles.summary: Frontier Airlines, Inc., a subsidiary of Frontier Group Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: ULCC), today announced the appointment of Michael Delehant as Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, effective November 30, 2026. The company also announced several other changes to its leadership team. In his new role, Delehant will oversee all aspects of operations and report to Frontier CEO Jimmy Dempsey. Delehant brings deep airline leadership experience to the role, most recently serving as Group Managing Director of Wizz Air, where he oversaw the airline's operational and commercial activities. His experience also includes senior leadership roles at Vueling, a Spanish low-cost carrier, where he most recently served as Chief Strategy and Network Officer, as well as a series of leadership positions at Southwest Airlines.
